svg.title: Per-camera decode and RAW to RGB times
svg.desc: Canon EOS R5 (RAW): decode FlashRaw 77.5 ms, LibRaw 134 ms, rawler 246 ms; Canon EOS 5D Mark IV (RAW): decode FlashRaw 20.0 ms, LibRaw 435 ms, RawSpeed 111 ms, rawler 256 ms; Nikon Z8 (14-bit lossless): decode FlashRaw 25.7 ms, LibRaw 544 ms, RawSpeed 220 ms, rawler 361 ms; Nikon Z6III (lossless): decode FlashRaw 14.7 ms, LibRaw 282 ms, RawSpeed 109 ms, rawler 190 ms; Sony A7 IV (compressed): decode FlashRaw 4.21 ms, LibRaw 87.7 ms, RawSpeed 8.02 ms, rawler 8.39 ms; Sony A7R V (lossless): decode FlashRaw 31.0 ms, LibRaw 775 ms, RawSpeed 22.1 ms, rawler 62.6 ms; Fujifilm X-T5 (lossless compressed): decode FlashRaw 33.3 ms, LibRaw 149 ms, RawSpeed 44.2 ms, rawler 93.7 ms; Panasonic Lumix S5II: decode FlashRaw 12.1 ms, LibRaw 131 ms, RawSpeed 61.2 ms, rawler 121 ms; OM System OM-1 Mark II: decode FlashRaw 107 ms, LibRaw 385 ms, RawSpeed 162 ms, rawler 227 ms; Leica M10-R: decode FlashRaw 20.6 ms, LibRaw 559 ms, RawSpeed 202 ms, rawler 387 ms; Hasselblad X2D 100C (compressed): decode FlashRaw 65.4 ms, LibRaw 1010 ms, RawSpeed 454 ms; Google Pixel 8 Pro: decode FlashRaw 14.9 ms, LibRaw 656 ms, RawSpeed 16.6 ms, rawler 34.0 ms
svg.text: Apple M1 Ultra, all cores, median of 7 runs · log scale, left is faster
Missing marker: that library does not decode the file (RawSpeed: Canon CR3; rawler: Hasselblad X2D). Full tables: docs/benchmarks.md.
